name: Example Content Patch
description: Minimal asset — required: id (safe_folder), url (https), dest (safe_relative_path).

name: Example Full Asset
description: All optional fields: repo_url (https), version (str), sha1 (40-hex), size (int>0), probe (bool).

name: Example Probe Asset
description: Asset with probe=false explicitly — launcher will not store response headers for this asset.

name: Example No-Version Asset
description: version/sha1/size are all optional — omit them for unpinned assets.

name: Example Subdir Asset
description: dest may be in a subdirectory — still must be a safe_relative_path (no traversal, no absolute).
